lame.min.js is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), unmodified, LGPL-3.0. See lamejs-LICENSE.txt.
It is loaded only when someone exports an MP3 from PENNIO Studio.
lame.min.js: one local change, Mp3Encoder takes an optional 4th argument (LAME quality 0 to 9, default 3 as shipped). The Studio passes 5.
